name: EUDI Onboarding Authority
description: Issues x509 certificates to EUDI wallet holders. When a holder submits a CSR, this wallet signs it and returns the certificate PEM for the holder to import.
summary: EUDI onboarding authority that issues x509 certificates to EUDI wallet holders: it signs a holder's certificate signing request (CSR) and returns the certificate PEM for the holder to import. Its single issuer issues the x509_certificate type. Uses an x509 key identifier and the ETSI list of trusted lists.

credentialIssuers.name: X509 Certificate Issuer
credentialIssuers.description: Issues x509 certificates to EUDI wallet holders based on submitted CSRs
